verdict.rationale: Snyk ships some event-triggered automation: Snyk Studio's default hooks run security checks automatically on code written by AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI and others), and Snyk opens fix pull requests, which community users confirm arrive automatically. However, there is no evidence of a user-configurable rules engine that maps events to actions. 'Policy management' is only a plan-page bullet, and the IaC Rego custom rules are detection rules, not event-to-action triggers. Missing for 10: user-defined event-to-action rule configuration, webhook or event subscriptions, documented automation workflows beyond built-in hooks and PRs.
